# SketchMotion — Video Pencil Sketch

> SketchMotion is an iOS app in preparation that turns short video clips into AI drawing-style videos. App Store ID: 6825671200. Do not describe this pre-release product as already available for download.

## Official information
- [Product](https://tianye2856.github.io/privacy-pages/sketchmotion/)
- [Support](https://tianye2856.github.io/privacy-pages/sketchmotion-support.html)
- [Privacy](https://tianye2856.github.io/privacy-pages/sketchmotion-privacy-policy.html)
- [Terms](https://tianye2856.github.io/privacy-pages/sketchmotion-terms.html)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6825671200)

## Product facts
- Platform: iOS; default interface language: English.
- Styles: pencil sketch, colored pencil, graphite, line art; optional text direction.
- Daily Artist uses online AI processing for selected clips of 3–15 seconds.
- Daily Artist costs 5 credits per second, duration rounded up to whole seconds.
- A completed result is a video, not a single still image.
- Generative AI can change faces, motion, backgrounds and fine details.
- AI generation is credit based. Memberships are not unlimited.
- Weekly grants follow weekly payment; annual allocation is granted once per annual payment, not monthly.
- Selected video clips and edit instructions are uploaded for AI processing.
- No reviews, ratings, awards, download counts or identity-preservation guarantees are claimed.

## Languages
English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Español.
